suggestions.title: Air Force 1 Low '07 - White/White
suggestions.verdict: The single most frequent shoe on the board, at a US retailer with your size in stock and under Nike's own $115.

matchReasons.detail: White AF1 is the most-repeated sneaker across the Pinterest corpus - the default under baggy light-wash denim.
Bright white is the one exception the profile allows to the worn-in/cream rule, and it is specifically the AF1 exception.
Retro basketball/court shape, not a chunky tech runner - matches the shoe shapes on the board.
$114.99 sits far under the ~$300 soft shoe ceiling.

provenance.foundVia: nike.com blocks automated page reads (HTTP 403), so the price was confirmed at a stocking US retailer instead
provenance.evidence: Retailer product page read directly 2026-08-06: price $114.99, colorway White/White, men's sizes 10.0 and 10.5 both shown available with no sold-out marker.
provenance.checkedBy: claude-opus-5 agent page-read (not a watcher run)
